unehrlich.et: From Middle High German [Term?]; un- + ehrlich. Cognate with Hunsrik uneherlich.

s: used to describe something as appearing like the outcome of two things being mixed
Armadillos sehen aus wie das uneheliche Kind von einer Ratte und einem Autoreifen.
Armadillos look like the bastard child of a rat and a car tyre.
unehelich.et: un- (“un-”) + ehelich (“marital”), further analyzable as un- (“un-”) + Ehe (“marriage”) + -lich (“-ly”)
